item.title: Pioneering industrial band Ministry is done. Take it from founder Al Jourgensen: 'It's time to go'
item.description: Ministry, the pioneering industrial rock band that paved the way for acts like Nine Inch Nails, is calling it quits after 45 years

item.description: U.S. futures are climbing as oil prices move lower after rising last week to their highest level in more than four years

item.title: 'You Can See Everything' surges with $19.5M at box office; 'Clayface' takes No. 1
item.description: DC Studios scored a modest, R-rated win with “Clayface,” landing a $24 million opening weekend, according to studio estimates Sunday

item.title: The SS United States is scheduled for sinking to become the world's largest artificial reef
item.description: A historic ocean liner is a step closer to becoming the world’s largest artificial reef

item.title: 9th Circuit questions DOJ demand to set aside 20,000 California mail ballots
item.description: A panel of federal appellate judges is questioning the Justice Department's demand that California election officials set aside thousands of mail ballots

item.title: More flooding in Four Corners region after storms bring heavy rain and at least one tornado
item.description: A rain-soaked swath of the Southwest U.S. has endured additional flooding after days of rain forced evacuations and water rescues

item.title: Nigeria evacuates Ebola patient to Switzerland as authorities monitor 52 contacts
item.description: A Swiss woman being treated for Ebola in Nigeria has been medically evacuated to Switzerland with her husband

item.title: Uganda tightens Ebola border controls and requires returnees from Congo to pay for quarantine
item.description: Uganda is reinforcing existing border controls requiring citizens returning from Congo to undergo 21 days of quarantine at their own expense, the Health Ministry said Sunday, as investigators examine how a woman who traveled from Uganda to Nigeria contracted Ebola

item.title: Calley Means, a key MAHA advocate, resigns as a top RFK Jr. adviser
item.description: A leading advocate for the Make America Healthy Again movement has resigned as a top adviser to Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Calley Means says he leaves with respect for President Donald Trump and Kennedy

item.title: Serbia's political veteran Vucic outplayed all opponents. Then the students came
item.description: Serbia’s populist leader Aleksandar Vucic has dominated politics in the Balkan country for 14 years

item.title: Saudi-led coalition says it has destroyed Yemeni rebels' missile facilities, and other Mideast news
item.description: The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed several Houthi tunnels and missile launchers in Yemen, weakening the rebels’ ability to strike Saudi Arabia

item.description: Ukrainian officials have disputed Elon Musk's claims that their military violated Starlink’s terms by using it for offensive drone strikes

item.title: UN-commissioned experts say Gaza ceasefire has not stopped Israel from committing genocide
item.description: A U.N.-commissioned group of independent experts accuses Israel of committing genocide in Gaza despite a ceasefire agreement
